headline: IMD: Cyclone Akvan's Landfall Zone Now Reaches Odisha, Noon 20 Nov
title: IMD's 18 Nov afternoon bulletins move Cyclone Akvan's expected landfall to between Narsapur and Puri around noon 20 Nov; Odisha districts shut schools 19-21 Nov

image.licence: Public domain (NASA EOSDIS GIBS / Worldview imagery, US government work)
image.author: NASA Worldview / EOSDIS GIBS, MODIS on the Aqua satellite, afternoon pass of 18 Nov 2026
image.subject: Cyclone Akvan over the Bay of Bengal, 18 Nov 2026 afternoon (Aqua) pass: convective core at about y 0.35-0.47 of the frame (about 13N/85.4E), sheared cloud shield to the north and north-east, Tamil Nadu coast and Sri Lanka's north at left, open sea in the lower half; bbox 3.5-18.5N, 78.9-90.9E. Different satellite and pass from the 12:26 cover (Terra, morning, bbox 7-21N 80-91.2E) and the 17 Nov cover (Terra, 16 Nov).

fact_sources.fact: IMD national bulletins No. 22 (issued 13:00 IST) and No. 23 (issued 14:30 IST) on 18 Nov: SCS Akvan likely to cross North Andhra Pradesh & Yanam and South Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri by noon of 20 Nov as a severe cyclonic storm, 90-100 km/h gusting to 110 km/h

IMD bulletin No. 21 (issued 09:30 IST, 18 Nov) had said: likely to cross Andhra Pradesh & Yanam coasts between Nellore and Visakhapatnam around noon of 20 Nov, 100-110 km/h gusting to 120 km/h; outlets report the change of landfall zone
IMD: isolated extremely heavy rainfall (>=21 cm) over coastal Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha on 19 and 20 Nov
IMD: along and off Odisha coast, gales of 70-80 km/h gusting to 90 km/h from 19 Nov morning till 20 Nov noon

IMD: storm surge of 0.5 to 1.0 m above astronomical tide likely to inundate low-lying areas of south coastal Odisha at landfall (bulletin names Ganjam, Khordha, Puri; Andhra: West Godavari, Konaseema, Kakinada, Vizianagaram, Srikakulam, Visakhapatnam)
Gajapati district education office: all schools (pre-primary to Class XII; govt, OAV, KV, JNV, aided, private) closed 19-21 Nov
Malkangiri Collector: all schools, colleges, other educational institutions and anganwadi centres closed 19 and 20 Nov
Khordha Collector: all govt, aided and private schools closed 19 and 20 Nov
Ganjam: schools and colleges closed from 19 Nov (Odisharay: till 20 Nov; Pragativadi: SRC order 19-21 Nov, so card says 'from 19 November')
Odisha Special Relief Commissioner suspended sea bathing, boating, water sports and other marine tourism at vulnerable beaches

fact_notes: Landfall wording is IMD's forecast, attributed. IMD's 13:30 IST press release said 'between Machilipatnam and Puri'; the later national bulletins (No. 22 at 13:00, No. 23 at 14:30) say Narsapur and Puri, which the card uses. Six-district SRC school order (adds Puri, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara, Kandhamal) has only Pragativadi, so those districts are left off. Evacuation-readiness figure (2,04,070) left out (one exact source). IMD DG 'no further intensification' left out because IMD's own track table shows 100-110 gusting 120 km/h on 19 Nov. Baseline warning from checkcopy is a false match (not a Tamil Nadu story). Bulletin times proven from the PDFs: No. 21 issued 09:30 IST (Nellore-Visakhapatnam); No. 22 issued 13:00 IST and RSMC advisory No. 14 issued 07:30 UTC = 13:00 IST (both Narsapur-Puri); No. 23 issued 14:30 IST (Narsapur-Puri). Sambad's 12:35 report of the new zone predates the earliest bulletin I can prove (13:00), so the caption cites the 1 pm and 2:30 pm bulletins, not Sambad's time. No Bulletin No. 24 on IMD's site at 17:27 IST.
